questions.questionText: What is the difference between the highest and the lowest rice production shown in the graph?
questions.explanation: Highest = 120, lowest = 35; difference = 120 - 35 = 85. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.

questions.questionText: In which year was the rice production the lowest?
questions.explanation: The smallest value is 35 lakh tonnes at 2021. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.
questions.shortcut: Look for the shortest bar.

questions.questionText: What is the total rice production of those years whose bar is above the average of all bars?
questions.explanation: Average = 85. Bars above it add to 430. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.

questions.questionText: The highest rice production exceeds the lowest by what percentage (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: (120 - 35)/35 × 100 = 242.86 ≈ 242.9%. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.
questions.shortcut: Base is the lowest value.

questions.questionText: If the bars of 2019 and 2020 are left out, what is the average rice production of the remaining 4 bars (correct to one decimal place)?
questions.explanation: Remaining total = 510 - 115 - 45 = 350; divide by 4 to get 87.5. Read the needed values straight from the graph data and apply the operation asked.
questions.shortcut: Subtract first, then divide by the reduced count.
